## D-580 · A PR in conflict only because of generated files brings itself up to date
**Date:** 2026-11-17 · **Status:** current · **Relation:** extends D-400 (wait-pr.mjs) · **Topics:** agents
**Context:** Many sessions work at once and every merge to `main` rewrites the same generated files: in three days `docs/DECISIONS.md` was touched by 60 merges, `docs/facts.json` and the README by 48. Open PRs went into conflict for hours with nothing of theirs actually clashing, and waited until their session came back.
**Decision:** `tools/agents/sync-pr.mjs` merges origin/main into the PR's branch; if the only conflicts are in generated files (the decisions index, `docs/facts.json`, conflicts inside the README's generated blocks, the rule counts in RULES.md, CONTRIBUTING.md and the PR template) it regenerates them, commits and pushes, and it always regenerates them after the merge. Any other conflict undoes the merge and is reported. `wait-pr.mjs`, run in the PR's own worktree, calls it once on a conflict and keeps waiting.
**Why:** A conflict nobody can lose anything in should cost no one's time; a real one still stops for the session.
**Consequences:** Waiters started outside the PR's worktree (another session's PR) only report. Lists edited by hand by many PRs (`public/labs/index.html`, `flag-list.js`) still conflict for real.
